entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The entire Palace has been rather[n]bizarre, but this room is rather strange[n]in its own way.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A CRT TV, huh? Talk about old school.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Look, it's even got a built-in VCR.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hmmm... Maybe we've gotta watch[n]some TV first?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Actually... there's a chance he's right.[n]There appears to be a tape by the VCR.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, it appears we don't have any[n]choice but to watch the tape, do we?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Of course, it could possibly just be[n]a trap.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's making some strange noises—could[n]it be broken?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Do you think we should try whacking it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, it's playing—stay on guard, everyone.
